read.title: October Sales Data Update
read.text:
To: Sales Team
From: Minsu

Here's a quick summary of our sales data for October. Total sales reached 420 million won, which is 8 percent higher than in September. Online sales went up by 15 percent, mainly thanks to the new sunscreen launch.

However, offline sales showed a slight decline for the second month in a row. This is largely because fewer customers are visiting department stores. We expect this trend to continue during the winter season.

I have attached a breakdown of sales by channel and region. Please check that the figures for your area are accurate and let me know of any errors by Wednesday. The final numbers will be included in our quarterly report to management.

Thanks,
Minsu
